# KaTeX 0.16.21

MIT-licensed KaTeX factory extracted from the installed official Visual Studio Code markdown-math extension. The unrelated VS Code activation code and Markdown plugin were excluded. A global/CommonJS export wrapper was added. Only MathML output is used; no remote scripts, CSS or fonts are loaded.
